command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== baseline ==="
cat /etc/os-release | head -3
id
echo "=== create dir ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/drop
echo "=== verify perms ==="
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /srv/drop
ls -ld /srv/drop
echo "=== functional test: two users, cross-delete blocked ==="
sudo -n useradd -m dropuserA 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n useradd -m dropuserB 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n -u dropuserA sh -c 'echo hello > /srv/drop/fileA.txt'
sudo -n -u dropuserB sh -c 'echo world > /srv/drop/fileB.txt'
ls -l /srv/drop
echo "--- B tries to delete A's file (should fail) ---"
if sudo -n -u dropuserB sh -c 'rm -f /srv/drop/fileA.txt' 2>/tmp/rmA.err; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "expected failure:"
  cat /tmp/rmA.err
fi
echo "--- A tries to delete own file (should succeed) ---"
sudo -n -u dropuserA sh -c 'rm -f /srv/drop/fileA.txt' && echo "A deleted own file OK"
ls -l /srv/drop
echo "=== cleanup test file B remains owned by B, dir still writable ==="
